    Method
    Description
    protected J
    ResourceClientBase.dryRunPatch(String serviceEndpoint, String uuid, List<PatchOperation> operations)
    Dry-run variant of ResourceClientBase.patchOne(String, String, List): sends the identical RFC 6902 JSON Patch request (same application/json-patch+json content type) plus the dryRun=true query parameter — per the spec, an "option to verify that API calls will succeed".
    protected J
    ResourceClientBase.patchOne(String serviceEndpoint, String uuid, List<PatchOperation> operations)
    PATCH a resource by uuid with an RFC 6902 JSON Patch operations array, sent with content-type application/json-patch+json.
